patthana18.29:1.1: saraṇaṃ dassanena pahātabbaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca na saraṇo na dassanena pahātabbo dhammo-. ekaṃ.
patthana18.29:2.1: araṇaṃ na dassanena pahātabbaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca na araṇo na na dassanena pahātabbo dhammo-. (saṃkhittaṃ)
patthana18.29:3.1: araṇaṃ sa uttaraṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca na na saraṇo na sa uttaro dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā,
patthana18.29:4.1: araṇaṃ anuttaraṃ. dhammaṃ paṭicca na sārammaṇo na sa uttaro dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā,
